assessment: The pathogenesis of human IgG4-mediated autoimmune diseases and the relevance of IgG4 autoantibodies remain incompletely understood and this study addresses an interesting issue on the role of IgG4 autoantibodies on disease pathology. By using FcgR knockout and engineered Abs, authors nicely show that IgG effector function mediates opposite functions, protecting or exacerbating the pathophysiology, depending on diseases.
